name: Vidángoz / Bidankoze (Spain)
description: Square flag with a red saltire over a field of white, yellow, blue and green triangles within a chevronny border, charged at the centre with the arms of the Roncal valley (the head of a king and a bridge on red).
history: The municipalities of the Roncal valley fly the flag of the valley, a red cross of Saint Andrew over a field of coloured triangles with the arms of the valley at the centre.

features.role: triangles of the field and chevrons of the border
